title: 第2章 我觉得，我还能再抢救一下！
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
考场里，七位考官居中一字排开，神色严肃地看着刚刚走进来的考生。

    现在是下午两点，按照常理，经过一连两天节奏紧凑的面试工作，难免会让考官们的精神懈怠，状态下滑，从而对后面考生的得分产生不利影响。

    然而出乎梁惟石意料的是，在场每一位考官的精神状态都十分饱满，一道道目光仿佛聚光灯一般，唰唰唰唰地照在了他的身上。

    梁惟石余光一扫，就发现了其中原委——考官后排的椅子上，正坐着几个气场强大的男女‘观众’。

    不用说，一定是市里领导过来视察了。

    否则身为主考官的县委办主任刘运生，不会摆出这种正襟危坐正气凛然正经八百的姿态。

    “各位考官下午好。我是十七号考生。”

    梁惟石中规中矩地问了好，并在听到‘考生请坐’之后礼貌地回了句‘谢谢’，才稳稳坐下。

    无论男女，几乎每个人都会对自己的第一次刻骨铭心。

    梁惟石也不例外。

    他在落选之后曾不只一次地去回想、复盘面试时的场景，时至今日，那四道面试题目依然清晰地刻在他的脑海深处。

    实事求是地说，2000年初公考面试，尤其是市县一级的面试难度与后来相比并不算高，不但清一色采用结构化面试方式，而且题目类型相对固定，有迹可寻。

    就比如面试第一题，基本就是白送，问的是对所报考岗位工作的了解，并让考生简单回答，在入职后该如何做好本职工作。

    梁惟石本打算随意敷衍几句就赶紧回家，因为他身体有些不适，尤其肩膀特别酸，那是即将背负一个商业帝国的前期症状！

    他是真不想在面试这种小事情上浪费时间。

    然而……当他看到坐在旁听席的十六号考生之后，立刻就改变了主意。

    能不能考上县委办对他不重要，但是不让余文宏这个王八蛋考上县委办对他来说很重要！

    就说上辈子他落难的时候，这个王八蛋可没少落井下石，包括他后来被调到警犬训练基地坐冷板凳，都是余文宏暗中使的坏。

    有仇不报非君子！

    如今报仇机会就在眼前，他又怎么可能放过？

    梁惟石脑中闪念，张口就答。

    先是言简意赅地阐明了岗位职责一二三四五，然后就如何做好本职工作的问题，他只回答了十六个字——‘认真做事，踏实做人，循规蹈矩，谨言慎行。’

    嗬，这个考生有点儿意思！
content_en:
In the examination room, seven examiners lined up in the middle, looking seriously at the candidates who had just walked in.

It is now two o'clock in the afternoon. According to common sense, after two consecutive days of fast-paced interviews, it is inevitable that the examiners will become slack and their state will decline, which will have an adverse impact on the scores of subsequent candidates.

However, to Liang Weishi's surprise, every examiner present was in high spirits, and their eyes were like spotlights, shining brightly on him.

Liang Weishi glanced out of the corner of his eye and discovered the whole story - several powerful male and female 'audiences' were sitting on the chairs in the row behind the examiner.

Needless to say, city leaders must have come to inspect.

Otherwise, Liu Yunsheng, director of the County Party Committee Office, who is the examiner, would not have such an upright and solemn posture.

"Good afternoon, fellow examiners. I am candidate No. 17."

Liang Weishi said hello in a decent manner, and after hearing "candidates, please take a seat", he politely replied "thank you" before sitting down firmly.

Regardless of gender, almost everyone will remember their first time deeply.

Liang Weishi is no exception.

After he was unsuccessful, he recalled and reviewed the interview scene more than once. To this day, the four interview questions are still clearly engraved in the depths of his mind.

To be honest, public examination interviews in the early 2000s, especially those at the city and county level, were not as difficult as later. Not only were all interviews using structured interviews, but the types of questions were relatively fixed, and there are traces of them.

For example, the first question in the interview is basically a free answer. It asks about the understanding of the job for which the candidate is applying, and asks the candidate to simply answer how to do a good job after joining the job.

Liang Weishi originally planned to say a few casual words and then go home quickly, because he was feeling a little unwell, especially his shoulders, which were early symptoms of being saddled with a business empire!

He really didn't want to waste time on such a trivial matter as an interview.

However...when he saw Candidate No. 16 sitting in the auditorium, he immediately changed his mind.

It doesn't matter to him whether he can get into the county party committee office, but it is important to him not to let Yu Wenhong, a bastard, get into the county party committee office!

Let's just say that when he was in trouble in his last life, this bastard often added insult to injury, including the fact that he was later transferred to the police dog training base and sat on the bench. It was all because of Yu Wenhong's secret mischief.

Not taking revenge is not a gentleman!

Now that the opportunity for revenge is right in front of him, how could he let it go?

Liang Weishi had a thought in his mind and opened his mouth to answer.

First, he succinctly and comprehensively explained the job responsibilities 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5, and then to the question of how to do his job well, he only answered sixteen words - 'Work seriously, be a down-to-earth person, follow the rules, and be cautious in your words and deeds.’

Hey, this candidate is a bit interesting!
title_en: Chapter 2 I think I can still save him a little more!
